card.name: Linking words before disease-risk terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "with", "increase" or "risk" that sit right before a named disease or condition, usually in phrases about risk or association.

modes.label: "of" after risk
modes.description: The word "of" after "risk" or a similar noun, leading into a disease name.
modes.example: Green tea and risk<< of>> breast cancer in Asian Americans.

modes.label: Risk-raising verbs and nouns
modes.description: "risk" or "increase" right before a cardiovascular or reproductive outcome.
modes.example: metabolic changes that may<< increase>> cardiovascular/cerebrovascular risk.

modes.label: "with" before a condition
modes.description: "with" after patients or associated, introducing a disease.
modes.example: two large, randomized controlled trials of patients<< with>> type 2 diabetes mellitus
